messages.author: 13d206290f78b126
messages.subject: climate dataset
parts: I was wondering while using package NicheMapR, whether we can use only global climate datasets, or we can use local climate datasets as well?

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: climate dataset
parts:
Hi Nasim,


You can certainly set the microclimate model up with your own local met observations. There’s a vignette on how to do this with monthly/daily data one for hourly data. Note that there’s also a function to run the microclimate model from a historical gridded daily product for the USA (gridMET – function micro_usa) and for a historical global gridded project (NCEP – function micro_ncep). There are lots of details on the R version of the model and how to run it, including all the vignettes, at this website:

 

https://mrke.github.io/

 

the specific vignettes I mentioned are:

 

https://mrke.github.io/NicheMapR/inst/doc/microclimate-monthly-input-example

 

https://mrke.github.io/NicheMapR/inst/doc/microclimate-hourly-input-example

 

All the best,
Mike
